adds.title: General Inspectorate of Justice of Santa Catarina - Resolution of 29 April 2013
adds.summary: On 29 April 2013 the Corregedoria-Geral da Justiça of Santa Catarina authorized notarial and civil-registry offices to process marriage habilitations regardless of the sex of the spouses without observance of gender limitation, allowing same-sex couples where both partners reside in Santa Catarina to formalize civil marriage and expanding Article 629 of the CGJ Code of Norms beyond stable union recognized since 2011.

adds.title: Complementary Law No. 527 - Governor Leonel Pavan / STF challenge
adds.summary: Santa Catarina Complementary Law No. 527 of 28 December 2010 penalizes private legal entities and, where applicable, state public servants that promote, permit or tolerate discriminatory acts based on gender or sexual orientation, defining as such violent, coercive, intimidating or vexatious acts, barring entry or stay in places of free public access, differentiated service not required by law, denying, preferring against or surcharging hotel/motel/pension lodging and rental/purchase/acquisition/lease/loan of movable or immovable property, and prohibiting expression of affection permitted to others, punishable by R$2,500 fine and R$5,000 on repeat plus 30-day suspension of annual license or revocation of monthly/daily/seasonal license with 30-day renewal bar with complaints to the State Secretariat of Public Security and Defense of the Citizen and fines to the State Civil Police Improvement Fund and up to 30-day suspension for state servants, while the Federal Supreme Court in ADI 5307 on 29 October 2018 unanimously declared Article 2 VI and VII formally unconstitutional.

adds.title: Supreme Federal Court (STF) - 1 March 2018 gender identity ruling
adds.summary: In 2018 in ADI 4275 the Federal Supreme Court held that equality without discrimination encompasses gender identity or expression and allowed alteration of name and gender in the civil registry without sex-reassignment surgery or judicial authorization because gender identity is a manifestation of personality that the State must recognize, and in ADO 26 and MI 4733 it equated transphobia together with homophobia to the crime of racism until Congress enacts criminalizing legislation, and in ADPF 527 it determined that transgender women prisoners be transferred to women's prisons with later requirement that custodial placement be fixed by reasoned judicial decision after questioning the detained person's preference, and in ADPF 787 it required the Unified Health System (SUS) to guarantee transsexual and travesti persons full access to health services and actions consistent also with biological sex, biological apparatus and physiological needs.

adds.title: Court of Justice of Santa Catarina / Supreme Federal Court - Florianopolis shopping mall restroom case 2014-2024
adds.summary: In Florianópolis, Santa Catarina, a trans woman blocked by shopping-mall security from using the women's bathroom won moral damages at first instance under the Consumer Defense Code but lost on appeal before the TJSC, and on 6 June 2024 the STF majority dismissed her appeal pending since 2014 and withdrew its recognized general repercussion on procedural grounds that the original claim pleaded only consumer-law damages and not constitutional provisions, thereby issuing no binding constitutional ruling on trans bathroom access.
